content.short: Business account, payments and financing platform in Southeast Asia.
content.description: Fazz is a Southeast Asian financial platform serving businesses from micro-merchants to larger companies across Singapore and Indonesia. Its Fazz Business account bundles multi-currency accounts, payment acceptance, disbursements, and working-capital financing so companies can collect, hold, and move money and access credit in one place. Fazz Financial Group also operates StraitsX, the regulated issuer of Singapore-dollar and US-dollar stablecoins (XSGD and XUSD), giving the group a foothold in stablecoin and blockchain-based payments infrastructure. For everyday business customers, Fazz focuses on practical financial operations — accounts, payments, and financing — that help SMEs and merchants in the region run and grow without stitching together multiple banking providers.
content.meta: Fazz offers business accounts, payments, and financing across Southeast Asia. Discover Fazz and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
